title: Fix null derefs reported by clang-analyzer
description:
Fix some potential null-pointer dereferences discovered by clang
analyzer via [scan-build][1]. Limited my changes to those where there
are similar null checks in related code in order to avoid false
positives.

[1]: https://clang-analyzer.llvm.org/scan-build.html
